name: Rex Research Institute
sideNote: Nominally a US-military weapons institute (Counter-Terrorist-aligned), but the birthplace of the Rex Virus and the origin of every early zombie boss; treated as the source of the zombie threat.
summary: The Rex Research Institute is the fictional organisation where the zombie apocalypse of Counter-Strike Online began. Founded by doctors and scientists developing life-prolonging medicine, it drifted toward the goal of human immortality; its experiments on living things backfired and produced the Rex Virus, which turns humans into zombies. The zombies escaped the lab during the Chaos chapter and spread the infection, and Jennifer was held there as a living test subject. Its director, Dr. Steve Rex, ran the classified Super Soldier Project that the virus was meant to serve.
description: An organisation of doctors and scientists who began by creating medicines to prolong life and gradually shifted to seeking a way to make humans immortal. Their continuous experiments on living organisms backfired and created the dangerous Rex Virus, which turns humans into the undead. Publicly the Rex Laboratory is best known as an institute producing American military weapons; its director Dr. Steve Rex is a leading bio- and mechanical engineer who led the Super Soldier Project behind closed doors.
lore: The zombies broke out of the lab in the Chaos chapter and began infecting others, isolating the surrounding Lost City. The institute is also where Jennifer was captured and kept alive as a human experimental subject. The main laboratory where the experiments took place was threatened with destruction by the Terrorists for political purposes (they managed to damage it only insignificantly); Yuri's bombing of the Rex facility is referenced elsewhere in the storyline. Dr. Rex remained hidden until revealing himself in the Envy Mask chapter, saying someone else (Douglas Jacob / Kronos) was continuing his super-soldier research. In Season 7, David Black and Erika return to the attacked Rex Labs looking for a cure for Erika. Rumour places the institute in Cuba: the Lost City map has posters written in Spanish, and Dead End takes place in Havana.
leaders: Dr. Steve Rex - director and mastermind of the outbreak
members: Psycho Zombies - former co-workers on the Super Soldier Program
Blotter Zombie - developed the Zombie Grenade
Female Researcher (Choi Ji Yoon's sister) - became Sting Finger
Soy (Soi) - participated in the Super Soldier Program for her PhD research
creations: Super soldiers (Titan, Ghost, Trooper, Lancer via Vanguard)
funders: Douglas Jacob / Kronos (secret funding after the government withdrew)
trivia: Rumoured to be located in Cuba (Spanish-language posters in Lost City; Dead End is set in Havana).
